full_page.content:
1935, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 69 Nov. 12 Mrs. Emiline Van Maele - 27 - Spinal m. .... .. very little hope re- ported. Enrolled at 4:15 p.m.
Edw'd Call .. . .
12 Tuesday - Loraine Taube - 5 - Spastic paralysis - concussion of brain at birth - operation too next Saturday. 19 - Astonishing! Operation practically unnecessary. Child astonishes doctors & nurses as well as parents !...!...!
13 Sheila Mahoney - 9 - had double pneumonia - crisis passed but heart is very weak. Her doctor asks prayers for her, feeling etc - the only remedy. -
Peter Aninos - 48 - nerveous Br'd'd
Page 70 Nov. 13 Clyde Jos. Prince (of Clyde Kanes) now in St. David's Parish - 8 - has Spinal maningitis when 3 and has never been able to hear since. November 3rd without any questions or knowledge of his folks or teachers he received his First Holy Communion ... Extremely happy at the experience, he came home beaming with joy - hoping to get his hearing. Wanted to know in the afternoon same day ... "How many times will I have to receive before I can hear?"
Mrs. C. Stewart ask prayers for brother who has been away from con- fession 30 yrs.
Ralph Schultz - convert - 50 - coughs for months - has wife and five small children ... Wife worries - laments discouragement & malady
Harvey Franco - 13 - defective since birth - now since July takes fearful fall.
Joseph Ventillio - 71 - heart trouble - wife 73 high-blood pressure & knee.
Page 71 Nov. 15 R. Darga & Lillian Bleeker - young people want to marry - Cath. & Baptist - want to satisfy parents.
Germain DeBacker - 14% of near Wayne - fearful pains in stomach and bowels - really in agony - Drs. wonder what
